title: design: webcam as its own track above the zoom (NIW2-565)
body:
## Summary

Design only — no code. Auto-zoom crops the face out of recordings because the camera bubble is a floating window burned into the screen pixels; there is no separate webcam file. This PR records how we fix that the way Cap, Screen Studio and Tella do.

- **Spec** `specs/2026-10-30-webcam-track-design.md`: one-minute block (9 decisions, defaulted open questions, out of scope, failures, acceptance criteria), then capture, sync, exclusion, vault, scene model, preview, export, back-compat, size (16–25 days; Plan B +5–8) and task order.
- **ADR 0032** — the webcam is its own track (`.kaipu/<id>.webcam.mp4`, same clock as the screen, start offset on the sidecar) and the bubble is excluded from the capture. **Plan A is chosen** (owner, 2026-10-30): Electron content protection on the bubble from creation. **Plan B is recorded, not scheduled**: native ScreenCaptureKit exclusion by window id, as Cap does, only if the spike fails, under its own ticket. Hiding the bubble is rejected.
- **ADR 0033** — the webcam is a viewport layer composed after the zoom crop and the output framing; Share composes it at the recorded layout.
- **Task 0** — the one-day exclusion spike, run by the owner by hand, with steps, pixels to check and the plan each outcome selects.
- Backlog page `backlog/webcam-track.md` (🔵 Proposed) + index row + sidebar entry; superseded note on capture-modes spec decision 6; note on the terminal-line bug page.

Owner answers folded in: Plan A chosen, Plan B recorded only, no hiding the bubble, 720p30 webcam, Share includes the webcam, spike first.

Linear: [NIW2-565](https://linear.app/niway/issue/NIW2-565)

## Verification

- Internal links in the new docs were checked against existing pages by script.
- `astro build` passes locally (347 pages) on 03520a08; CI skips the docs build for this PR. The `#35-task-0--the-exclusion-spike` anchor exists in the built spec.
- Pre-push `verify:local` (lint, oxfmt, build, types) passed on push.

- Agent review findings (offset sign, webcam width, pre-2004 Windows) fixed in df0abc99; replies in each thread.

## How to test it yourself

1. `bun run dev` in `apps/documentation` (or open the preview deploy).
2. Open **Backlog → Webcam track**: the 🔵 banner shows and links to the spec and both ADRs.
3. Open the spec: the decisions table renders, and section 3.5 "Task 0 — the exclusion spike" lists the takes, the pixels to check, and the outcome → plan table.
4. Open **Architecture → Decisions**: 0032 and 0033 appear at the top of the index as Proposed.
5. On the bug page "control bar hides last terminal line", the link to Task 0 jumps to that section.
